department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
scheme_objective: Recognize the unpaid household care work of women, enhance female economic autonomy, and mitigate poverty through a monthly basic income transfer of Rs 1,000 directly into bank accounts.
target_population: Adult female heads of economically disadvantaged families residing in Tamil Nadu.
eligibility_criteria: Family annual income below Rs 2.5 lakh; family landholding below 5 acres wetland or 10 acres dryland; annual domestic electricity consumption below 3,600 units; no family member paying income tax or employed in government service.
geographic_scope: Statewide across all 38 revenue districts of Tamil Nadu.
expected_outcomes: Enhanced financial resilience for vulnerable households, improved nutrition and healthcare spending autonomy among women, and reduced reliance on informal high-interest debt.

scheme_name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Pudhumai Penn)
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department / Higher Education Department
scheme_objective: Prevent child marriage and dropouts among adolescent girls by incentivizing graduation and diploma enrollment with a direct financial incentive of Rs 1,000 per month.
target_population: Girl students who studied continuously from Classes 6 to 12 in government schools in Tamil Nadu and enrolled in undergraduate or diploma courses.
eligibility_criteria: Must have studied Classes 6 to 12 in Tamil Nadu government schools; currently enrolled in recognized college degree, polytechnic diploma, or ITI course; benefit paid till regular course completion.
geographic_scope: Statewide across all higher education institutions in Tamil Nadu.
expected_outcomes: Substantial increase in female Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) in higher education, reduction in female early marriage rates, and expanded formal workforce participation.

scheme_objective: Eliminate barriers to chronic non-communicable disease (NCD) treatment by deploying Women Health Volunteers to screen, diagnose, and deliver essential medications directly at citizens homes.
target_population: Citizens aged 45 and above, individuals requiring palliative care, physiotherapy, peritoneal dialysis, or hypertension and diabetes management.
eligibility_criteria: Residents of Tamil Nadu with confirmed or suspected hypertension, diabetes, physical mobility limitations requiring palliative care, or kidney disease.
geographic_scope: Statewide coverage across all primary healthcare blocks and municipal corporations.
expected_outcomes: Early detection of cardiovascular risks, high continuous adherence to hypertension and diabetes therapy, and reduction in catastrophic out-of-pocket medical expenditure.

department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department / Municipal Administration Department
scheme_objective: Alleviate classroom morning hunger, eliminate nutritional deficits among primary schoolchildren, and boost school enrollment, daily attendance, and learning retention.
target_population: Children studying in Classes 1 to 5 in government primary and middle schools.
eligibility_criteria: Enrolled student in Classes 1 to 5 in any government or local body primary/middle school in Tamil Nadu.
geographic_scope: Statewide across all 31,008 government primary schools.
expected_outcomes: Elimination of morning malnutrition, marked improvement in morning classroom alertness and cognitive performance, and increased attendance stability in rural and municipal schools.

scheme_name: Naan Mudhalvan Skill Development and Employability Scheme
department: Special Programme Implementation Department / Tamil Nadu Skill Development Corporation
scheme_objective: Equip 10 lakh higher secondary and college students annually with industry-aligned technical, coding, green energy, language, and soft skills to improve graduate employability.
target_population: Students in engineering colleges, arts & science colleges, polytechnics, and ITIs across Tamil Nadu.
eligibility_criteria: Active enrollment in any state university, affiliated government, aided, or approved engineering/arts college in Tamil Nadu.
geographic_scope: Statewide across over 1,300 colleges and educational institutions.
expected_outcomes: High campus recruitment rates, narrowing of industry-academia technical competence gaps, and higher starting salaries for youth from non-metro colleges.

scheme_objective: Mitigate severe foundational learning loss and reading deficits caused by extended COVID-19 pandemic school closures through evening volunteer-led learning centers in residential habitations.
target_population: Students studying in Classes 1 to 8 in government and aided schools.
eligibility_criteria: Schoolchildren attending Classes 1 to 8 residing in habitations with active Illam Thedi Kalvi volunteer centers.
geographic_scope: Statewide across rural habitations, urban slums, and tribal settlements in Tamil Nadu.
expected_outcomes: Restoration of age-appropriate reading and arithmetic competence, prevention of learning dropouts, and community mobilization for public schooling.

scheme_name: Innuyir Kaappom - Nammai Kaakkum 48 Emergency Trauma Care Scheme
scheme_objective: Save lives of road accident victims by guaranteeing cashless emergency medical and surgical treatment up to Rs 1 lakh for the critical first 48 hours in empaneled hospitals.
target_population: Any individual sustaining a road traffic accident within the geographical territory of Tamil Nadu, regardless of domicile, nationality, or insurance status.
eligibility_criteria: Victim of a road accident occurring on any highway, road, or street in Tamil Nadu; presented to an empaneled government or private hospital within the golden hour.
geographic_scope: Statewide across all state and national highway networks and 680+ empaneled hospitals.
expected_outcomes: Drastic reduction in preventable highway trauma fatalities, immediate access to emergency neurosurgery and intensive stabilization without financial friction.

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Urban Solid Waste Management & Sanitation Mission
department: Directorate of Municipal Administration / Greater Chennai Corporation
scheme_objective: Achieve 100% source segregation, mechanized collection, waste-to-energy processing, and bio-mining remediation of legacy dumpsites across urban local bodies in Tamil Nadu.
target_population: Urban citizens and commercial establishments in 25 municipal corporations and 138 municipalities.
eligibility_criteria: All residential, commercial, and institutional waste generators located within municipal limits.
geographic_scope: Urban areas of Tamil Nadu with high focus on Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.
expected_outcomes: Substantial reduction in unsegregated landfill dumping, remediation of toxic legacy dumpsites, and mitigation of urban sewage and drainage blockages.
